additional_info.subject: 0439727 - ID0439727-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197001] POWER_SAVE mode active CRM:00314000220
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Gomes,
I am reaching out form the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0439727.
Apologies for the delayed answer.
The ticket was opened for an issue on charger
Y2/R3 313020197001
to start a charging session while being in Power Save Mode.
I took the time to look at the logs and to understand, and discovered that the issue happened due to a known bug. In practice, the issue was in a timer for the power converters to re-allocate the CAN addresses when exiting the power saving mode.
The bug is already fixed, and it is included in FW >= v6.1.3. The latest released FW is v7.0.5, so I would proceed to update the charger to the latest FW version, which includes the bugfix of this issue.
I will provide you an update as soon as the updates are done.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
